crossRefs.note: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.
When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they not die; or when they come near to the…
How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: They washed whenever they entered the Tent of Meeting or approached the altar, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: when they went into the tent of meeting, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
